evals.name: sheets-to-slack-integration
evals.prompt: Build me an n8n workflow: when a new row is added to a Google Sheet, take the row contents and post them as a message to our Slack #leads channel. Give me the workflow JSON I can import.
evals.expected_output: Valid importable workflow JSON with a Google Sheets trigger node connected to a Slack node, correct connection format (keyed by node name, array-of-arrays), settings with executionOrder, and a note about wiring credentials.

evals.name: scheduled-rss-email-hungarian
evals.prompt: Készíts egy n8n workflow-t, ami minden reggel 8-kor lekéri egy RSS feed (https://news.ycombinator.com/rss) új elemeit, és elküldi őket nekem e-mailben. Kérem a workflow JSON-t.
evals.expected_output: Valid importable workflow JSON with a Schedule Trigger set to 08:00 daily, an RSS Feed Read node, and an email send node, correctly connected, with settings.executionOrder set.

evals.name: ai-agent-with-tool-and-memory
evals.prompt: I want an AI agent chatbot in n8n that uses OpenAI as the model, has a calculator tool, and remembers the conversation. Build the workflow.
evals.expected_output: Valid workflow JSON using @n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain nodes: a chat trigger, an AI Agent root node, an OpenAI chat model connected via ai_languageModel, a calculator tool via ai_tool, and a memory node via ai_memory. Connections use the ai_* types, not main.
